route_title: Transition-Zone Seed Re-initialization with Damped Optimization
compilation_rationale: Compiles a fixed 24-layer HfO2/SiO2 sequence with explicit bounds per specification. Optimizes thicknesses to maximize passband transmittance and stopband reflectance under coherent TMM. Robustness incorporates ±15 nm absolute normal tolerance. Gradient descent uses 20% reduced step size. Performance targets serve as soft ranking metrics only.
